messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — webinar landing + paid push next Tue. Need final plan for search + retargeting, creative refresh, and inbound lead routing into Salesforce. Can we lock pacing and owners today?
Alex Rivera: For pacing I suggest frontload — 40% budget in first 48h to hit CPA signal then smooth 60% over remaining days. Keep daily caps per geo.
Jordan Kim: Creative: 3 headlines x 2 CTAs x 2 image sizes (16:9 + 4:5). We should swap a refreshed hero after 72h if CTR dips >15%.
Priya Patel: Landing/form: add company size + use-case checkbox + hidden utm_campaign field. Route leads with utm_campaign=webinar_apr23 to SF queue: Webinars_APR23. Add priority = high for SQL qualification.
Sam Ortiz: Retargeting windows: 0-7d (high intent), 8-30d (mid), 31-90d (low). Exclude converters for 30d. Frequency cap 6/day for high-intent. Also double-check pixel firing on the /thanks page.
Alex Rivera: Also recommend dynamic search ads for branded + competitor queries, cpc bid +10% for top performing geos. Pause low-converting keywords after 72h of spend.
Maya Chen: Good. Who's owning creative refresh and who wires the inbound mapping?
Jordan Kim: I'll own creative assets & refresh cadence. I'll drop initial comps by EOD.
Priya Patel: I'll own the SF routing + form fields, I'll add mapping to Pardot and post-test routing. Can verify automation and lead owner assignment.
Sam Ortiz: I'll audit tracking and set up GA goals, confirm conversions into SF.
Alex Rivera: I'll handle search/retarget setup + pacing rules. Quick naming conv: use adgroup_campaign_webinar_geo_variant.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Action items:
- Jordan: assets (3 headlines, 2 CTAs, 2 sizes) — due EOD today
- Priya: SF routing + form & utm mapping — due EOD today
- Sam: tracking audit + conversion pixels — due tomorrow 10am PT
- Alex: campaign setup + pacing rules — due tomorrow noon PT
Also confirm budget: $18k total, $7k first 48h, remainder $11k over 12 days. Who ok's final numbers?
Jordan Kim: Ok from creative side.
Priya Patel: Ok from ops.
Maya Chen: I'll approve final budget after Alex posts the daily pacing breakdown.
marketing-bot: Reminder: account daily spend limit = $5,000. If you exceed this, campaigns will pause automatically. See https://ad-platform.example/limits
Alex Rivera: FYI — I'll set the cap per account to avoid hitting platform limit; will post the pacing table in this thread when ready.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — small follow-up: include one control creative that matches last webinar for A/B quality baseline.
Jordan Kim: Noted, adding control creative now.
Maya Chen: Great. Closing this thread after assets & routing are confirmed. :thumbsup:
